notes: Merged old k44 Bomber jacket and k45 MA-1 flight jacket into one Flight jacket kind with A-2, G-1, MA-1, B-3, Irvin, B-15, B-10, B-6, CWU-45/P, L-2B and N-2B archetypes; old models became versions (Alpha Heritage, Schott 184SM/237, Cockpit USA, Chapal, Gloverall) and three unplaced models (Cockpit CWU-55/P, Canada Goose Chilliwack, Avirex leather bomber) stay in m. Merged k57/k58 into Field jacket with M-41, M-43, M-51, M-65, French M-47, Safari and Greenland archetypes; Aspesi Lambrettone and Gloverall Oak stay in m. New Deck jacket kind (N-1 1944; USN A-2 deck jacket). Souvenir jacket (k50) rebuilt around the Yokosuka sukajan archetype with Tailor Toyo and Wacko Maria versions and a Yokosuka embroidery tradition entry; dropped the single old model (WORKER PLAYGROUND Pander Rocker) as one-shop retail noise. Left out: The Real McCoy's A-2 and Cockpit USA N-1 (seen only in search snippets, not retrieved pages); Margn Vertebrae Bomber (fashion SKU with no archetype). Aspesi, Gloverall, Chapal, Sugar Cane/Tailor Toyo (covered under Toyo Enterprise) and Abercrombie & Fitch not given brand entries because no brand page with usable facts was retrieved or they belong to other shelves. Schott founding year left blank (not in retrieved page). B-10 and B-6 dated only to the decade because no retrieved page states the spec date. Sources: Wikipedia (Flight jacket, A-2, G-1, MA-1, M-1941/1943/1951/1965, Safari jacket, Sukajan, brand pages), vintageleatherjackets.org B-15 spec thread, History Preservation (Buzz Rickson's, Eastman, B-3, N-1), Alpha Industries history page, Heddels N-1 and Tailor Toyo articles, maker pages (Aero Leather, Real McCoy's, Pike Brothers, Iron Heart, Fjällräven, Rothco, Coulange, Son of a Stag/Toys McCoy, HBX/Wacko Maria).
